title: Cancel or the close icon discards the window's contents
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Choose a name for term A, that no term has.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type the name of term A in Name.
  3. Click "Cancel".
  4. Click "New Credit Term".
  5. Type the name of term A in Name.
  6. Click the close icon at the top right of the window.
  7. Click "New Credit Term".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Credit Term" window opens.

Step 2:

  • The Name reads term A.

Step 3:

  • The window closes.
  • No toast shows and no term A row is added.

Step 4:

  • The "New Credit Term" window opens with Name and both boxes empty.

Step 5:

  • The Name reads term A.

Step 6:

  • The window closes without saving.
  • No term A row is added.

Step 7:

  • The "New Credit Term" window opens empty again.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-N3: “"Cancel" or the close icon closes the window without saving and clears its contents; reopening "New Credit Term" starts empty.”
